description: Configure a numbered quick-action slot for a room the account owns.

action_number.description: Quick-action slot number (1–16). Slots 5–16 require the room owner to have Pro.

input_type.description: Detail every press of this action must carry: none (default), location (data.location), link (data.url), file (any attachment), photo (jpg/png attachment) or pdf (pdf attachment). A press without it is a 422 quick_action_input_required.

label.description: Button label. Must be sent, but may be empty ("") — a Ping can be named by its emoji alone, and clients render an untitled one as just the emoji.

requires_ack.description: Whether pings from this action remain open until one eligible recipient acknowledges them.

sound.description: Canonical sound id, e.g. "ting". Omit for the room default.

name: update_quick_action

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Update Quick Action
